arch_izu: Marek Izu unpacked his mother's thimble at R-F9. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Marek Izu wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Dawn watch. Marek Izu put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar, grazed.
Marek Izu laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
